THE NAMES

Named after the sky

Sua is the Muisca word for the sun, and the name of the universe that holds it all: the sun, the moon and the star. Each of our homes carries one of those lights, and each name has a story behind it.

Xia Xue

The sun and the moon

Our first home, named for Sué, the sun god, and Chía, the moon goddess, husband and wife in Muisca myth, who follow each other across the sky. Pablo is the sun. Patricia is the moon. The name itself holds them both: Xia for Chía, Xue for Xué, another name of Sué.

Fagua

The star

Fagua means "star" in Muysccubun, the language of the Muisca. It is named for our daughter Mariana, the star of the family.

IeChie

The path to the light

A house of three levels that climb toward the light. At the top, a window opens onto the rooftops of La Candelaria.

Three homes, three lights, one family.

MEET YOUR HOSTS

The family behind the houses

We are Pablo, Patricia and Mariana, a family from Bogotá.

We love to travel, and in our travels we have learned what a traveler looks for in a place to stay. That is what we have tried to bring into our apartments, so every guest feels at home.

When you write to us, you talk to us directly, in English or Spanish. No company in between. We answer every message ourselves.

GOOD TO KNOW

Before you arrive

When are check-in and check-out?

Check-in begins at 3:00 pm and check-out is by 11:00 am. Xia Xue, IeChie and Céntrico19 are fully self check-in; entry instructions for Céntrico19 are shared one day before arrival. Fagua welcomes guests in person between 3:00 and 9:00 pm.

Can I bring my pet?

Xia Xue House is pet friendly. Mention your pet when you book on Airbnb.

Is there parking?

Xia Xue includes one parking space in the building when requested at booking. Public 24-hour parking is available close to IeChie.

Can I do laundry?

Xia Xue House and Céntrico19 have a washer and dryer inside the apartment. Fagua and IeChie do not.

Are the fireplaces available?

Xia Xue and Fagua have working wood fireplaces. IeChie's historic fireplaces are decorative and must not be lit.

How do I book?

Each house is listed on Airbnb. Open the house you like above and book there, or use the direct booking section on this page for Xia Xue, IeChie and Céntrico19, or write to us on Instagram @suahouses with any question before you book.

Already booked? Complete your guest registration

Colombian law asks every guest to register before arrival. Use the Sua Houses check-in form for your house. It takes a couple of minutes.

How can I contact you?

Write to us at suahouses@gmail.com, or send us a message on Instagram @suahouses or WhatsApp +57 301 501 3948.
